culprit_citations.quoted_text: BCRED Emerald JV LP Consolidated Schedule of Investments September 30, 2023 (in thousands) (Unaudited)

findings.detail: The extracted pct_of_net_assets sum of 208.2893 does not tie to the parent schedule total of 185.14, while the filing contains separate BCRED Emerald JV LP investment schedules with their own percent-of-net-assets basis.

rationale: PCT01 is an aggregate issue. The filed parent Blackstone Private Credit Fund schedule reports Total Investment Portfolio at 185.14% of net assets for September 30, 2023. The flagged extracted aggregate is 208.2893%, so it does not tie to the source schedule total. The source also presents separate BCRED Emerald JV LP consolidated schedules, indicating a likely look-through/scope classification leak rather than a source-supported parent aggregate.
